'''July 2001 Levittown tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Tri-County card show, Levittown, NY on 7 July 2001. [[John Curran]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2596">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-levitown-ny-7-7-01d2596/ levitown-ny-7-7-01], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 8 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-levitown-ny-7-7-01d2596/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Tri-County card show, Levittown, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[John Curran]]
